query: Using 'player_value_corr_causal_train.csv' as the training set and 'player_value_corr_causal_test.csv' as the test set, build a linear regression model to predict 'market_value_in_eur'. Keep only numerical feature columns (excluding the label). Train the model on the training set and report the RMSE on the test set as the final answer.

You are a senior football scout. Using 'player_value_corr_causal_train.csv' as the training set and 'player_value_corr_causal_test.csv' as the test set, build a linear regression model to predict 'market_value_in_eur'. Use numerical feature columns. Only select features that have a causal relationship with market value (e.g., direct performance stats that drive a player's valuation), and exclude columns that are merely correlated by coincidence. Train the model on the training set and report the RMSE on the test set as the final answer.
